This dev pack is designed to help you integrate fire control group reinforcement into your design. There are also instructions for ordering the plates from a laser cutting supplier. These plates should help solve the most common FCG issues with 3d printed receivers using AR-15 Hammer, Trigger, and Safety Selector.

These plates mount on the outside and are held in place with anti-rotation pins. PLEASE READ THE README FOR FULL INSTRUCTIONS
